item.description:
# What's New in TablePro 0.89.0-beta.1
### Added
- The connection password can be set to store in the Keychain or ask every time from a menu. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - A connection can carry an Environment label: Production, Staging, Development or Local. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - SurrealDB statement completions in the editor once connected. ([#4399](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4399)) - Picking a custom slash command that uses {{body}} puts it in the AI chat composer to finish before sending. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Keyboard shortcut rows have a context menu with Record Shortcut, Remove Shortcut and Reset to Default. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Extensions installs several plugins at once with Install from File…, or by dropping them on the pane. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Manage Themes is its own page in Appearance, and Undo of a theme change still works after going Back. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Each AI provider opens as its own page, with Edit Connection… for its name, Base URL and API key. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings > Account has Devices, Teams, and Offline File and License Key pages, and Sign Out… asks first. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Custom slash commands have their own page in Settings > AI. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - General has Software Update and Command Line Tool pages, and the Software Update row shows a pending update. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings > MCP has Tokens and Approved Connections pages. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings pages keep Back and Forward history, and tablepro://settings links can open a page inside a pane. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - SSH profiles can be duplicated, and SSH passwords, passphrases and TOTP secrets have Show toggles. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Paste a connection URL into Host to fill the connection editor. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Test Connection shows the server version and time, and names the step that failed. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Closing or quitting with unsaved connection edits asks whether to save them. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Copy a connection as a URL, without its passwords, from the connection editor. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Option-click on a close button asks one Review Changes question for every window with unsaved changes. ([#4431](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4431)) - SQLite CHECK value lists now also show in completion, Generate Rows and the MCP describe_table tool. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - Each filter row has a play button, and Option-Command-Return, to apply only that row without changing any checkbox. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460))
### Changed
- The macOS connection editor is one scrolling form instead of a sidebar of panes. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - Refine the macOS connection form: tinted engine tiles in the Type row and database chooser, a resizable chooser sheet, and consistent notice, editor and remove-button styles. ([#4398](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4398)) - Compare & Sync is now a module in Settings > Extensions: it stays on for existing installs and starts off on new ones. ([#4404](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4404)) - The connection editor opens on the core fields, with SSL, tunnels, appearance and advanced options behind disclosures. ([#4410](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4410)) - Sync is now iCloud Sync, with What Syncs on the same page and editable while sync is off. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings > Data is regrouped, and Query result limit is one pop-up with a No limit choice. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Linked Folders and Trusted Links moved to Settings > Connections, and Forget All… asks first. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Revoke… for MCP tokens and Forget All… for approved connections ask before they act. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Uninstalling an extension moves it to the Trash. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The Settings window can be minimized, and its size resets once to fit the new layout. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Reassigning a shortcut held by several actions names each one and clears them all in one step. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Clear Saved Changes in Data Rewind works without a license. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - SSH Servers in Settings > Profiles is now SSH Profiles. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Keyboard settings search sits in the toolbar, and Restore Defaults… asks before resetting every shortcut. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings moved to a macOS sidebar layout, with General split into General, Sidebar & Tabs and Connections. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The device limit and offline file notices open the matching page in Settings > Account. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Show line numbers moved under Gutter in Editor settings, and SQL Formatting shows its preview first. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The Default AI policy in Settings > AI and the connection form's AI Policy show while AI features are off. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Lists in Settings have a native add and remove bar inside their border. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The long-running work threshold in Notifications can be changed while notifications are off. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings labels lost their trailing colons, and help moved from tooltips into subtitles. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The Welcome window opens faster, and the tags you filter by show in a bar above the connection list. ([#4415](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4415)) - Environment shows on Welcome rows and in the connection switcher, and Production defaults Safe Mode to Alert. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - The connection editor is a window with a sidebar of sections, and New Connection asks for the database type first. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Scrolling a grid with hundreds of columns uses about a third less CPU. ([#4426](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4426)) - Switching to or opening a table with hundreds of columns is more than twice as fast. ([#4426](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4426)) - TablePro opens faster, most of all when it runs in a language other than English. ([#4430](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4430)) - Deleting a connection also deletes its agent sessions and their conversations. ([#4431](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4431)) - Open Quickly no longer reloads the database and schema lists after you open a table or run a query. ([#4433](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4433)) - The sidebar filter shows each key at once when the list redraws quickly, instead of waiting 150 ms after every key. ([#4433](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4433)) - Open Quickly updates its results while you type on catalogs with tens of thousands of tables. ([#4433](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4433)) - SQL exports run about ten times faster, and XLSX exports are about a tenth of their old size. ([#4434](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4434)) - Exports of very wide rows, and ClickHouse exports, no longer hold the whole result in memory. ([#4434](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4434)) - Switching back to a database browsed in the last five minutes shows its objects without reading them again. ([#4445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4445)) - A COMMIT or ROLLBACK of data changes no longer rereads the sidebar; DDL inside the transaction still refreshes it. ([#4445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4445)) - Opening a table and saving a change send fewer queries, and a table's keys no longer wait for its row estimate. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - The first query on a PostgreSQL connection no longer waits for a savepoint check. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - A SELECT in a query tab no longer counts the whole table it reads from. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - The filter bar shows whether its rows are applied, and Clear is now Turn Off. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Filter settings moved from the filter bar to Settings > Data > Filters. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460))
### Removed
- TablePro no longer keeps a table load timing history file, and removes the one older versions left. ([#4435](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4435))
### Fixed
- The same connect timeout resolved to different values on macOS and iOS. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - Closing the connection editor during a connection test left the test's password in the Keychain. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - Editing a connection deleted on another device opened a blank form that only failed on Save. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - Reveal the connection form’s Advanced section when a field hidden inside it fails validation. ([#4398](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4398)) - Copied SQL Server connection URLs started with `sql server://` once the driver had loaded. ([#4399](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4399)) - DuckDB: an empty binary value saved or imported into a BLOB column stays empty instead of turning into NULL. ([#4400](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4400)) - On iOS, a SQLite table's generated columns were missing from its structure. ([#4405](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4405)) - SQLite: a statement given fewer values than it has placeholders ran with NULL in the rest instead of failing. ([#4405](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4405)) - SQLite: an empty binary value saved or imported into a BLOB column stays empty instead of turning into NULL. ([#4405](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4405)) - On iOS, an Oracle connection waited 30 seconds to sign in, whatever connect timeout it had. ([#4407](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4407)) - On iOS, an Oracle table's identity and virtual columns were offered as ordinary values in the new row form. ([#4407](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4407)) - After a slash command filled the AI chat composer, typed text landed before the command. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings pop-ups were blank when a stored value, such as a page size or a removed font, was not on the list. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - TablePro notifications stayed silent when Play sound for notifications was on in System Settings. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Saving an SSH profile while the Keychain was locked deleted its stored password, passphrase or TOTP secret. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Clearing Query History or Data Rewind could fail without showing an error. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - A custom slash command typed with text after its name went to the model as plain text. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The query timeout field in the connection form read Global (0) instead of the time it inherits. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - A connection's secrets could be deleted when its SSH or credential profile changed while the editor was open. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - The file panel froze the app while browsing the Documents folder. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Saving a connection reverted a rename, group move or Safe Mode change made elsewhere while the editor was open. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Save stayed disabled by a field that was not on screen. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Test Connection kept showing Connected after the host or password changed. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Port fields accepted 0, 99999 or a port with spaces. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - JSON values over 500,000 characters showed unindented in the inspector, the JSON viewer and Pretty Print. ([#4427](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4427)) - The JSON result view counted rows past the 50,000 it shows. ([#4427](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4427)) - Stepping through rows with a large JSON value in the inspector took seconds per row. ([#4427](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4427)) - Typing, completion and running the statement at the caret got slower as a script grew. ([#4428](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4428)) - Opening a long script in a window's first editor took seconds and gigabytes of memory. ([#4428](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4428)) - Accessibility apps read a wrong character count from the query editor when the text held emoji. ([#4428](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4428)) - Vim commands like x, r, ~ and o added or removed auto-paired brackets and quotes. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Switching query tabs carried the previous tab's caret and scroll position into the new tab. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Approved write tool calls from one AI chat reply could run at the same time and out of order. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Clicking a Redis database replaced the selected tab and its unsaved commands, staged edits or sort. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - A jump host that asks for a code after the key (publickey,keyboard-interactive) could not sign in. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Closing a connection that was still connecting left its SSH tunnel open until quit. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Transfer Tables wrote into the destination session's current schema; it now has a Schema picker. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Typing in a value window popped out of the inspector could change a row in another tab or another record. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Save and Save on close wrote a query result's edits but skipped the tab's unsaved .sql file. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Syncing a settings change from an older Mac reset options a newer build had set, such as Emacs key bindings. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - View ER Diagram was missing from the Favorites menu for a table in a schema named default. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - An ER diagram of a schema named default refreshed and saved against the schema the sidebar moved to. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Clear All in the query parameter panel cleared only the last parameter. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Stop and keep what ran in Compare & Sync reported changes PostgreSQL had rolled back as applied. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Long AI chat conversations with tool calls stopped sending after the transcript was trimmed. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare & Sync Apply sent its own BEGIN and COMMIT into a transaction already open on DuckDB or PGlite. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare & Sync listed tables, views and routines in two schemas as one-sided instead of pairing them. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare showed a timestamptz copied into a column without a time zone as changed after every sync. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare & Sync offered to create or drop a table whose counterpart in the other schema could not be read. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Hide Column and Show All Columns did nothing in the Structure tab. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Vim's . repeated an older change instead of the last one, such as dd, J, ~ or text typed in Insert mode. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - A moved column snapped back in a query result that had a hidden column. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - The window's close button closed it without asking about unsaved changes or running work. ([#4431](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4431)) - Every closed connection window stayed in memory, about 47 MB each. ([#4431](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4431)) - Pressing Return right after typing in the Welcome search could select a connection the search was about to hide. ([#4432](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4432)) - Excel repaired an XLSX export holding a value over 32,767 characters; such values are now cut, with a warning. ([#4434](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4434)) - View state stayed behind for deleted connections and for every database file or link ever opened. ([#4435](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4435)) - A plugin installed from the registry without a build for this Mac's processor failed to load instead of updating. ([#4446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4446)) - A capped PostgreSQL or SQLite query with parameters held its whole result in memory before cutting it to the limit. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - A large table's estimated row total went blank after saving an edit. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - A SQLite CHECK constraint listing numbers offered a value picker with blank entries. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - Share Result and Fetch All quoted the whole table's row count for a query result filtered by a WHERE clause. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - The Query menu's page commands could replace a query tab's SQL with a generated table query. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - Renaming or dropping a column in the Structure tab left filters on the old column. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Down and Return in a filter value could pick from a suggestion list that had already closed. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Search All Rows stopped filtering on the next page, sort or refresh. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Removing a filter row also ran unapplied edits in the other rows. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Hidden columns were missing from the filter column menu. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - The filter bar and status bar said no filter was applied while one still ran. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Filter presets forgot Match all or Match any. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Remove All Filters left an empty filter bar with no way to add a row. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Reopening a table ran its saved filter rows instead of the filter it was showing. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460))
### Security
- An outside MCP server's token must be entered again when its address moves to another scheme, host or port. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - A synced SSH or credential profile deletion could mark an externally edited connections file as trusted. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - MCP explain_query with an actual plan committed its statement under Manual Commit. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - The AI chat's destructive tool ran in the current database while its approval card named another one. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - An AI or MCP call naming another database on SQLite ran in the current database instead of failing. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Publishing to the Team Catalog wrote tunnel commands and startup commands in plain text to the shared folder. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429))
[View release notes](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/releases/tag/v0.89.0-beta.1)

([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Show line numbers moved under Gutter in Editor settings, and SQL Formatting shows its preview first. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The Default AI policy in Settings > AI and the connection form's AI Policy show while AI features are off. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Lists in Settings have a native add and remove bar inside their border. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The long-running work threshold in Notifications can be changed while notifications are off. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings labels lost their trailing colons, and help moved from tooltips into subtitles. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The Welcome window opens faster, and the tags you filter by show in a bar above the connection list. ([#4415](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4415)) - Environment shows on Welcome rows and in the connection switcher, and Production defaults Safe Mode to Alert. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - The connection editor is a window with a sidebar of sections, and New Connection asks for the database type first. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Scrolling a grid with hundreds of columns uses about a third less CPU. ([#4426](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4426)) - Switching to or opening a table with hundreds of columns is more than twice as fast. ([#4426](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4426)) - TablePro opens faster, most of all when it runs in a language other than English. ([#4430](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4430)) - Deleting a connection also deletes its agent sessions and their conversations. ([#4431](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4431)) - Open Quickly no longer reloads the database and schema lists after you open a table or run a query. ([#4433](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4433)) - The sidebar filter shows each key at once when the list redraws quickly, instead of waiting 150 ms after every key. ([#4433](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4433)) - Open Quickly updates its results while you type on catalogs with tens of thousands of tables. ([#4433](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4433)) - SQL exports run about ten times faster, and XLSX exports are about a tenth of their old size. ([#4434](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4434)) - Exports of very wide rows, and ClickHouse exports, no longer hold the whole result in memory. ([#4434](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4434)) - Switching back to a database browsed in the last five minutes shows its objects without reading them again. ([#4445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4445)) - A COMMIT or ROLLBACK of data changes no longer rereads the sidebar; DDL inside the transaction still refreshes it. ([#4445](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4445)) - Opening a table and saving a change send fewer queries, and a table's keys no longer wait for its row estimate. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - The first query on a PostgreSQL connection no longer waits for a savepoint check. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - A SELECT in a query tab no longer counts the whole table it reads from. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - The filter bar shows whether its rows are applied, and Clear is now Turn Off. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Filter settings moved from the filter bar to Settings > Data > Filters. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460))
### Removed
- TablePro no longer keeps a table load timing history file, and removes the one older versions left. ([#4435](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4435))
### Fixed
- The same connect timeout resolved to different values on macOS and iOS. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - Closing the connection editor during a connection test left the test's password in the Keychain. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - Editing a connection deleted on another device opened a blank form that only failed on Save. ([#4391](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4391)) - Reveal the connection form’s Advanced section when a field hidden inside it fails validation. ([#4398](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4398)) - Copied SQL Server connection URLs started with `sql server://` once the driver had loaded. ([#4399](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4399)) - DuckDB: an empty binary value saved or imported into a BLOB column stays empty instead of turning into NULL. ([#4400](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4400)) - On iOS, a SQLite table's generated columns were missing from its structure. ([#4405](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4405)) - SQLite: a statement given fewer values than it has placeholders ran with NULL in the rest instead of failing. ([#4405](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4405)) - SQLite: an empty binary value saved or imported into a BLOB column stays empty instead of turning into NULL. ([#4405](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4405)) - On iOS, an Oracle connection waited 30 seconds to sign in, whatever connect timeout it had. ([#4407](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4407)) - On iOS, an Oracle table's identity and virtual columns were offered as ordinary values in the new row form. ([#4407](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4407)) - After a slash command filled the AI chat composer, typed text landed before the command. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Settings pop-ups were blank when a stored value, such as a page size or a removed font, was not on the list. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - TablePro notifications stayed silent when Play sound for notifications was on in System Settings. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Saving an SSH profile while the Keychain was locked deleted its stored password, passphrase or TOTP secret. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - Clearing Query History or Data Rewind could fail without showing an error. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - A custom slash command typed with text after its name went to the model as plain text. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - The query timeout field in the connection form read Global (0) instead of the time it inherits. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - A connection's secrets could be deleted when its SSH or credential profile changed while the editor was open. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - The file panel froze the app while browsing the Documents folder. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Saving a connection reverted a rename, group move or Safe Mode change made elsewhere while the editor was open. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Save stayed disabled by a field that was not on screen. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Test Connection kept showing Connected after the host or password changed. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - Port fields accepted 0, 99999 or a port with spaces. ([#4417](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4417)) - JSON values over 500,000 characters showed unindented in the inspector, the JSON viewer and Pretty Print. ([#4427](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4427)) - The JSON result view counted rows past the 50,000 it shows. ([#4427](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4427)) - Stepping through rows with a large JSON value in the inspector took seconds per row. ([#4427](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4427)) - Typing, completion and running the statement at the caret got slower as a script grew. ([#4428](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4428)) - Opening a long script in a window's first editor took seconds and gigabytes of memory. ([#4428](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4428)) - Accessibility apps read a wrong character count from the query editor when the text held emoji. ([#4428](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4428)) - Vim commands like x, r, ~ and o added or removed auto-paired brackets and quotes. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Switching query tabs carried the previous tab's caret and scroll position into the new tab. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Approved write tool calls from one AI chat reply could run at the same time and out of order. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Clicking a Redis database replaced the selected tab and its unsaved commands, staged edits or sort. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - A jump host that asks for a code after the key (publickey,keyboard-interactive) could not sign in. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Closing a connection that was still connecting left its SSH tunnel open until quit. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Transfer Tables wrote into the destination session's current schema; it now has a Schema picker. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Typing in a value window popped out of the inspector could change a row in another tab or another record. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Save and Save on close wrote a query result's edits but skipped the tab's unsaved .sql file. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Syncing a settings change from an older Mac reset options a newer build had set, such as Emacs key bindings. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - View ER Diagram was missing from the Favorites menu for a table in a schema named default. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - An ER diagram of a schema named default refreshed and saved against the schema the sidebar moved to. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Clear All in the query parameter panel cleared only the last parameter. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Stop and keep what ran in Compare & Sync reported changes PostgreSQL had rolled back as applied. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Long AI chat conversations with tool calls stopped sending after the transcript was trimmed. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare & Sync Apply sent its own BEGIN and COMMIT into a transaction already open on DuckDB or PGlite. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare & Sync listed tables, views and routines in two schemas as one-sided instead of pairing them. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare showed a timestamptz copied into a column without a time zone as changed after every sync. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Compare & Sync offered to create or drop a table whose counterpart in the other schema could not be read. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Hide Column and Show All Columns did nothing in the Structure tab. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Vim's . repeated an older change instead of the last one, such as dd, J, ~ or text typed in Insert mode. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - A moved column snapped back in a query result that had a hidden column. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - The window's close button closed it without asking about unsaved changes or running work. ([#4431](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4431)) - Every closed connection window stayed in memory, about 47 MB each. ([#4431](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4431)) - Pressing Return right after typing in the Welcome search could select a connection the search was about to hide. ([#4432](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4432)) - Excel repaired an XLSX export holding a value over 32,767 characters; such values are now cut, with a warning. ([#4434](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4434)) - View state stayed behind for deleted connections and for every database file or link ever opened. ([#4435](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4435)) - A plugin installed from the registry without a build for this Mac's processor failed to load instead of updating. ([#4446](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4446)) - A capped PostgreSQL or SQLite query with parameters held its whole result in memory before cutting it to the limit. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - A large table's estimated row total went blank after saving an edit. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - A SQLite CHECK constraint listing numbers offered a value picker with blank entries. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - Share Result and Fetch All quoted the whole table's row count for a query result filtered by a WHERE clause. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - The Query menu's page commands could replace a query tab's SQL with a generated table query. ([#4458](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4458)) - Renaming or dropping a column in the Structure tab left filters on the old column. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Down and Return in a filter value could pick from a suggestion list that had already closed. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Search All Rows stopped filtering on the next page, sort or refresh. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Removing a filter row also ran unapplied edits in the other rows. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Hidden columns were missing from the filter column menu. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - The filter bar and status bar said no filter was applied while one still ran. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Filter presets forgot Match all or Match any. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Remove All Filters left an empty filter bar with no way to add a row. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460)) - Reopening a table ran its saved filter rows instead of the filter it was showing. ([#4460](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4460))
### Security
- An outside MCP server's token must be entered again when its address moves to another scheme, host or port. ([#4413](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4413)) - A synced SSH or credential profile deletion could mark an externally edited connections file as trusted. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - MCP explain_query with an actual plan committed its statement under Manual Commit. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - The AI chat's destructive tool ran in the current database while its approval card named another one. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - An AI or MCP call naming another database on SQLite ran in the current database instead of failing. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429)) - Publishing to the Team Catalog wrote tunnel commands and startup commands in plain text to the shared folder. ([#4429](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4429))
[View release notes](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/releases/tag/v0.89.0-beta.1)

# What's New in TablePro 0.88.0
Share a query, a saved query or a result as a link anyone can open in a browser, with sensitive columns masked first.
iPhone and iPad export tables, results, selected rows or a whole database, and import CSV, JSON, XLSX and SQL files.
The editor tab bar scrolls and drags like the macOS one, tabs move between windows, and a query tab can be renamed.
Wrap Text shows long values on several lines in the data grid, and Option-Return opens a cell's value editor.
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SSH tunnels and large results take fewer round trips and less memory, and Vim mode acts more like Vim.
The setting that wrapped editor tabs onto more rows is gone.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

item.description:
# What's New in TablePro 0.88.0-beta.3
### Added
- Share a query, a saved query or a result as a link anyone can open in a browser. ([#4253](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4253)) - Share Result masks columns that look sensitive before upload, and lets you keep, mask or remove each column. ([#4253](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4253)) - Open a shared link in TablePro to get its SQL in a new query tab, without running it. ([#4253](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4253)) - Select several rows on iPhone and iPad to export, copy or delete them. ([#4302](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4302)) - Import CSV, JSON and XLSX files into a table, and run SQL files, on iPhone and iPad. ([#4302](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4302)) - Export tables, query results, selected rows or a whole database to a file on iPhone and iPad. ([#4302](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4302)) - Drag an editor tab onto another window of the same connection to move it there. ([#4323](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4323)) - Name a query tab by double-clicking it or choosing Rename Tab, and the name stays after a restart. ([#4343](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4343)) - Open a cell's value editor from its context menu, the Query menu, or Option-Return. ([#4374](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4374)) - Double-click a PHP serialized value in a read-only result to open it in the viewer. ([#4377](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4377)) - Wrap Text in the data grid shows long values on several lines, up to 10 lines a row. ([#4378](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4378))
### Changed
- Typing in the query editor no longer redraws the tab strip and the rest of the window on every keystroke. ([#4286](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4286)) - Restore Dump's database picker shows favorite databases and their menu, like the toolbar switcher. ([#4303](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4303)) - The editor tab bar now scrolls, animates and drags like the macOS tab bar. ([#4323](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4323)) - Fetch All on PostgreSQL uses less memory, and binary columns load much faster. ([#4328](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4328)) - TLS connections to PostgreSQL 17 and later skip a round trip once the server is known. ([#4328](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4328)) - PostgreSQL connections open faster and a table's columns load in one round trip. ([#4328](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4328)) - Row totals stay in place while you page through a table, until you refresh or change the filters. ([#4330](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4330)) - Spanner, Cloudflare D1 and SurrealDB tables are counted only when you choose Count Exactly. ([#4330](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4330)) - SSH tunnels transfer large results many times faster over high-latency connections. ([#4331](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4331)) - libSQL queries stop at the row limit instead of downloading the whole result first. ([#4331](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4331)) - Snowflake table columns and details load without a running warehouse. ([#4331](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4331)) - Oracle results that stream in fetch 1,000 rows per round trip instead of 50. ([#4331](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4331)) - Large ClickHouse results decode about 2.7 times faster. ([#4331](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4331)) - Elasticsearch deep pages no longer download the documents they skip. ([#4332](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4332)) - Memcached key browsing reads a page of values in one request. ([#4332](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4332)) - Redis key browsing loads a page in fewer round trips on databases with 10,000 keys or more. ([#4332](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4332)) - MongoDB collection pages load without an extra round trip to the server. ([#4332](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4332)) - CSV and JSON exports of large tables finish several times faster. ([#4333](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4333)) - Refreshing a database with thousands of tables now updates only the sidebar rows that changed. ([#4334](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4334)) - VoiceOver reads the data grid columns on screen, and scrolling sideways brings in the next ones. ([#4335](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4335)) - Opening a table redraws the data grid once instead of several times. ([#4335](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4335)) - Selecting hundreds of thousands of rows in the data grid stays responsive. ([#4335](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4335)) - Wide tables and long values draw and scroll faster in the data grid. ([#4335](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4335)) - Large results use less memory, and the first edit in one no longer pauses to copy every row. ([#4340](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4340)) - Typing on a long line with line wrapping off no longer lays out every visible line again. ([#4340](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4340)) - Typing in a very large SQL file no longer pauses while syntax highlighting catches up. ([#4340](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4340)) - ROW_COUNT() and SHOW WARNINGS on MySQL and MariaDB answer for your last statement, not for a database switch. ([#4341](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4341)) - A MySQL or MariaDB query with a row limit sends the limit together with the query. ([#4341](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4341)) - MySQL and MariaDB no longer switch database before each statement, so paging and running queries take half the time. ([#4341](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4341)) - Opening a MySQL or MariaDB table reads its columns in one round trip. ([#4341](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4341)) - PostgreSQL and SQL Server results take less CPU to read. ([#4342](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4342)) - Table tabs open sorted by their primary key unless you chose another default row sort. ([#4344](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4344)) - The first page of a Kafka topic loads with one request per broker instead of one per partition. ([#4349](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4349)) - Cassandra table pages after the first load without preparing the query again. ([#4349](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4349)) - The Data Dictionary export reads a PostgreSQL schema's columns, keys and indexes in one pass, not table by table. ([#4350](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4350)) - BigQuery statements that finish within two seconds return in one request, without the half-second wait each one had. ([#4352](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4352)) - DuckDB connections now refuse SET threads below the number of processors. ([#4354](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4354)) - A PostgreSQL SQL export reads each schema's indexes, comments, sequences and enum types in one pass, not table by table. ([#4355](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4355)) - A PostgreSQL SQL import with Wrap in transaction on sends its writes in batches, not one statement at a time. ([#4356](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4356)) - A PostgreSQL SQL import stops at a statement read before an earlier write changed standard_conforming_strings. ([#4356](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4356)) - Tables open a round trip sooner from the columns read with the schema, and a bar offers Reload if they changed since. ([#4357](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4357))
### Removed
- Removed the setting that wrapped editor tabs onto more rows. ([#4323](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4323))
### Fixed
- Switching tabs cleared the undo history of grid edits still waiting to be saved. ([#4283](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4283)) - One connection TablePro could not read emptied the whole connection list and blocked saving. ([#4283](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4283)) - After a reconnect lost a transaction, a grid save used up the warning meant for your next statement. ([#4283](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4283)) - Choosing Save when closing a tab could save another tab instead if the selection changed while the prompt was up. ([#4286](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4286)) - Query History saved the statements of a script without their schema, so reopening one ran in the default schema. ([#4286](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4286)) - Query Insights grouped statements without the engine's quoting and comment rules, such as PostgreSQL's `'C:\'`. ([#4289](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4289)) - Importing a SQL file joined the words around a dropped comment, so `a/* x */FROM t` ran as `aFROM t`. ([#4289](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4289)) - Importing a SQL file split a PostgreSQL `E'...'` string continued on the next line, or a SQLite `$name(...)` parameter. ([#4289](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4289)) - The editor flagged a bracket inside a `$$` body, a `[name]`, a MySQL `#` comment or PostgreSQL's `'C:\'` as unmatched. ([#4289](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4289)) - On iOS, a ROLLBACK after a MySQL `#` comment or a nested PostgreSQL comment left the transaction shown as open. ([#4289](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4289)) - Renaming a SQL Server column failed, or renamed the wrong one, when a schema or table name held a dot or a bracket. ([#4294](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4294)) - XLSX export dropped leading and trailing spaces in text cells. ([#4302](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4302)) - SQLite SQL exports dropped NUL characters inside text. ([#4302](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4302)) - SQL exports wrote wrong trigger or routine drops for Cassandra, Teradata, SQL Server aggregates and DuckDB macros. # What's New in TablePro 0.87.0
Read-Only and Safe Mode hold on more engines, and the AI assistant and MCP clients see only what a connection allows. A Local only connection keeps its passwords off iCloud Keychain.
The tablepro command line was rebuilt, and 21 AI clients can be set up in one click from Connect a Client.
Table Health exports its findings, remembers resolved ones and runs more checks.
Query tabs keep earlier versions of their text under File > Revert To, and Manual Commit holds a connection's changes until you commit.
The grid colors values by type, and large results, queries and startup use less time and memory on macOS and iOS.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

# What's New in TablePro 0.86.0
Sign in with a TablePro account to use your plan, see your devices and sync a team library. A license key from an earlier version moves into your account the first time the app opens.
A dropped connection keeps its rows while it reconnects, with Cancel, and every surface shows the same connection state.
Imports, exports, backups, restores and transfers share one progress sheet, and Quit, Close and Disconnect ask once about work still running.
Remote DuckDB connections can go through an SSH tunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel, SOCKS proxy or tunnel command, and now require the Token instead of secrets in ~/.duckdb.
A raw SQL filter can no longer run a second statement, and a DuckDB token no longer reaches another server that a later ATTACH names.
Sending feedback from inside the app is no longer available.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)
